title: Ask HN: How do you kill time while LLMs work for you?
excerpt: I know Pi has a Doom plugin. I've heard some folks watch ads to get some money (Kickback). Others spin more agent sessions. What's your strategy, if any? How do you make that time more productive?
content_html:
Ask HN: How do you kill time while LLMs work for you?
2 points by theletterf 21 hours ago | hide | past | favorite | 3 comments

I know Pi has a Doom plugin. I've heard some folks watch ads to get some money (Kickback). Others spin more agent sessions. What's your strategy, if any? How do you make that time more productive?

 help


Depends.

Is this for work? If so then QA, verification and similar tasks of a senior looking after juniors. They're book-smart and all that jazz but they're still juniors.
